name: Xiaomi MiMo Desktop
desc: Desktop AI agent that turns work files into finished deliverables
desc_zh: 小米的桌面 AI 应用，把素材做成可编辑的成果
solves: Scattered spreadsheets, PDFs and recordings take hours to turn into slides or reports. MiMo Desktop reads them, plans tasks and delivers editable files.
solves_zh: 素材散、格式乱，整理成文档和 PPT 很费时。它读完自己拆任务、调工具，交出可继续改的文件。
best_for: A folder of charts, photos and notes has to become a client deck by tomorrow morning.
best_for_zh: 明天要交一份客户汇报，手里只有一堆图表、照片和零散笔记的时候。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://mimo.mi.com/ (featured card 'Xiaomi MiMo 桌面客户端正式发布') and https://mim）。 DATE NEEDS REVIEWER ATTENTION.
